project: Majin and the Forsaken Kingdom - Recomp USA (0.0.0.2)

sub_82150000.description: Configures guest viewport base dimensions (1280x720), calls XNotifyPositionUI and initializes the primary display context via sub_82161F90.

sub_824750E0.description: Central render loop exit point. Prepares the primary command buffer, calls __imp__VdSwap (0x82ADE2D4), advances the frontbuffer ring and flushes GPU submissions.

sub_82475748.description: Executes post-scene passes (sub_8246C5A0, sub_82474CB0, sub_824684F0, sub_8246C4F0, sub_8246BAC0) before invoking sub_824750E0.

sub_823DED70.description: Evaluates frame render flags, executes 3D pass and UI pass, then conditionally calls either sub_824750E0 or sub_82475748 based on frame state.

sub_8247BB60.description: Guards presentation under RtlEnterCriticalSection, checks pending buffer flags at context offset +10942, calls sub_824750D8 and sub_824750E0.

sub_828D6980.role: Title & Main Menu State Machine Loop
sub_828D6980.description: Manages SceneTitleLogo transitions, title menu idle updates, UI element rendering triggers, and user input polling.

__imp__VdSwap.description: Packages the Direct3D 9 frontbuffer fetch constant and posts PM4_XE_SWAP packet to the GPU ringbuffer with width and height.

modes: kHostRenderTargets (FBO) - lacks pixel shader interlock, breaks custom UI blends
modes.fsi: kPixelShaderInterlock (FSI) - full EDRAM buffer emulation via VK_EXT_fragment_shader_interlock

modes.rov: kPixelShaderInterlock (ROV) - Rasterizer Ordered Views EDRAM buffer
